description: This file defines the CandidateView class, which is a custom Android View used for displaying suggested words (candidates) in an Android soft keyboard. It manages rendering suggestion strings, handling touch interactions for selecting suggestions, and scrolling through suggestions when they exceed the view width.

classes.name: CandidateView
classes.description: A custom View component for displaying candidate suggestions in an Android soft keyboard, handling their rendering, user interaction, and scrolling.

methods.name: CandidateView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes visual and gesture settings for the candidate suggestions view.

methods.name: setService
methods.description: Links the CandidateView to the SoftKeyboard service to perform actions like selecting suggestions.

methods.name: computeHorizontalScrollRange
methods.description: Returns the total width of all suggestion candidates for scrolling purposes.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Determines the size of the view based on suggested dimensions and padding.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Renders the suggestions list, highlights selected candidates, and manages horizontal scrolling.

methods.name: scrollToTarget
methods.description: Performs smooth scrolling to the target scroll position for overflowing suggestions.

methods.name: setSuggestions
methods.description: Populates the view with a list of suggestion strings and resets scroll and selection states.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the suggestions displayed and resets selection and touch states.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles user touch interactions like taps and drags to select and scroll suggestions.

methods.name: takeSuggestionAt
methods.description: Programmatically selects a suggestion based on an x-coordinate, useful for flick gestures.
